text.Birikimini vadeli mevduatla değerlendir: Put your savings to work with a time deposit
text.Vadeli mevduat hesabı, birikimini belirl: A time deposit account is a safe option that lets you earn interest income by keeping your savings at a bank for a set term. Interest rates vary by term and by banks' campaigns. It is both a safe and a profitable way for those who want to grow their savings without risk.
text.Vade boyunca paranı çekmediğin sürece fa: As long as you don't withdraw your money during the term, you earn interest income. At maturity, your principal and your interest income after withholding tax are transferred to your account.
text.Vade süresini nasıl seçmeli?: How should you choose the term?
text.Vade sonundan önce paranı çekersen faiz: If you withdraw your money before maturity, you may lose interest. So when choosing the term, consider your financial needs and make sure you won't need the money until maturity. Short terms offer flexibility, while long terms let you lock in the interest rate.
text.Türkiye’deki bankalarda tutulan tasarruf: Savings deposits held at banks in Türkiye are protected by the Savings Deposit Insurance Fund (TMSF) up to an amount set each year.

text.Vadesi dolmadan paramı çekebilir miyim?: Can I withdraw my money before maturity?
text.Çekebilirsin, ancak vade sonundan önce ç: You can, but with a time deposit withdrawn before maturity the interest earned is usually lost. We recommend choosing a term based on how long you won't need the money.
text.Stopaj, mevduat faiz gelirinden kaynakta: Withholding tax (stopaj) is the tax deducted at source from deposit interest income. The bank deducts it when it pays the interest into your account; the net return in the calculator is the amount after this deduction. Since the rate can vary by term, you can change it in the calculator.
text.Türkiye’deki bankalarda tutulan tasarruf: Savings deposits held at banks in Türkiye are protected by the Savings Deposit Insurance Fund (TMSF). Deposits are insured up to an amount set each year.
text.Faiz getirisi ne zaman hesabıma geçer?: When will the interest be credited to my account?
text.Vadeli mevduatta faiz getirisi vade sonu: With a time deposit, the interest is transferred to your account at maturity, together with the principal, after withholding tax is deducted.
